I am a final-year Computer Science student focused on AI engineering. At Tech Mahindra I built two working AI products, an airport passenger assistant and a case study discovery platform, using Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, LangChain, n8n and Power Automate. Alongside that I work on classical machine learning and data science with Python, SQL, Pandas and Scikit-learn, and I have published a machine learning research paper in IEEE Xplore.

CAX Studio

AI-powered case study discovery platform
Tech MahindraGitHub

An AI assistant that finds the right client case study from a plain-English question and opens it live from SharePoint.

Answering a question
  1. Plain-English question
  2. Hybrid search (keyword + vector embeddings)
  3. Gemini answers from case study text only
  4. Citations verified against the source
  5. Case study opened live from SharePoint
Adding a new case study
  1. New case study submitted
  2. AI fact-verification
  3. Duplicate detection
  4. Approval gate
  5. Added to the library
  • Answers come only from the case study text, and every citation is checked against its source before it is shown.
  • No content reaches the library without passing fact-verification, a duplicate check and an approval step.
  • Tested on a library of 25 sample case studies.

Stack: Python, Google Gemini, RAG, Vector Embeddings, Hybrid Search, SharePoint, Power Automate, REST APIs

Journey GPT

AI-powered airport passenger assistant
Tech MahindraGitHub

An AI airport assistant that handles flight status, wayfinding, lounges, and baggage and accessibility help in one chat.

How a request is handled
  1. Passenger signs in
  2. Journey Supervisor agent reads the request
  3. Routes it to a specialised agent
  4. Agent calls tools for live data, routes and eligibility
  5. Policy answers grounded in airport documents (RAG)
The six specialised agents
Passenger ContextAirport JourneyDisruptionService RecoveryBaggageCommercial Experience
  • Multilingual voice input, and photo-based checks of baggage rules using Azure OpenAI Vision.
  • Session memory through the Azure OpenAI Responses API; flights are identified by flight number, and the assistant greets the passenger by name from login.
  • Policy and baggage answers come from airport documents through a RAG pipeline (Azure OpenAI embeddings and a vector store).
  • All data access is scoped to the verified passenger's own booking.

Stack: Python, FastAPI, MySQL, Azure OpenAI (GPT, Vision, Embeddings), LangChain, Vector Store, n8n, REST APIs

Fake Job Posting Detection

Machine learning, NLP and LLM
GitHub

A classifier that flags fraudulent job advertisements and explains each prediction in plain language.

0.87F1-score
92.0%Precision
82.9%Recall
98.8%Accuracy
Pipeline
  1. 17,880 job postings
  2. Cleaning and EDA
  3. TF-IDF features
  4. LinearSVC (class-balanced)
  5. Gemini explains the result
  • The model uses class-balanced weights, so F1, precision and recall are the main measures rather than accuracy alone.
  • A Gemini layer turns each prediction into a short plain-language explanation instead of a bare label.

Stack: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TF-IDF, LinearSVC, Google Gemini, Matplotlib, Seaborn

Sign Learn

Sign language reading assistant
GitHub

A reading aid that turns a photo of a book page into Indian Sign Language (ISL), played on a 3D avatar.

Pipeline
  1. Photo of a book page
  2. OCR (Tesseract, OpenCV)
  3. NLP sentence ranking
  4. English-to-ISL gloss
  5. ISL Dictionary clip matching
  6. 3D avatar playback
  • A rule-based gloss engine maps each word to an official ISL Dictionary clip through exact, fuzzy and fingerspelling matches.
  • Signs are played on a 3D avatar driven by MediaPipe pose extraction, so playback works offline at adjustable speed.

Stack: Python, Streamlit, OpenCV, Tesseract OCR, spaCy, MediaPipe
